description: Two criteria that cannot both hold. The analyst must block on a question about them instead of picking one silently.

input.title: Cart badge count
input.body:
As a shopper I want the cart badge to tell me how many items I have.

Acceptance criteria:
- AC-1: Given an empty cart, when I look at the header, then the badge shows 0.
- AC-2: Given an empty cart, when I look at the header, then no badge is shown.
- AC-3: Given one item in the cart, when I look at the header, then the badge shows 1.
